headline: Wardens Gain in Weathered Expanse; Mooring County Fighting Renewed
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has shifted since the last edition: Wardens now stand on six of its nine squares against three Colonial, with the heaviest work at Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk and fresh events logged as this dispatch went to press. Casualty rolls there are climbing on both sides, the Warden tally the steeper. Fisherman's Row, brisk three hours ago about Eidolo and Black Well, has gone silent through the last two hours; its colours remain seven Colonial to two Warden. Callahan's Passage continues to grind at The Crumbling Passage, six events in two hours and eleven in six, Wardens holding eight squares of ten. Mooring County remains lively, Wiccwalk, The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast in play, while Linn Mercy has filed three sharp events in two hours at Rotdust. Stlican Shelf keeps Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost under fire, its line split four Warden to five Colonial. Stema Landing, Palantine Berm and Nevish Line have gone quiet. Colonials retain the great majority of the map, holding sole colours over thirty-one regions.
